PART III - LANDS

FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 208 (Nuwaraeliya) Whereas a settlement notice under Section 4 of the Land Settlement Ordinance was duly published in the Gazette No. 55 of 21th Sep-tember 1979, and as otherwise required by the said Section, in respect of the lands situated in the village of Galauda in Galauda Grama Sewaka’s Division in Udahewaheta D.R.O’s Division (Now Hanguranketha Divisional Secretary’s Division) of the Nuwaraeliya Dis-trict in the Central Province and described as Lot nos. Inset No. 08 136, 137, 138, 139, 140, 141, 142, 143, 144, 145, 145 1/2, 146, 147, 148, 149, 150, 151, 153, 154, 154, 156, 157, 158, 159, 160, 161, 162, 164, 166, 167, 168, 169, 170, 171, 172, 173 ,174 Inset No. 09 180, 181, 182 and 183 in Block Survey Topo Plan No. 15 (Central) (Vide Settlement Notice No. 4847 (Nuwara Eliya)). And whereas all claims received in pursuance of the said notice have been duly dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the said Ordinance: I, the undersigned, in pursuance of the powers conferred on me by Section 5(5) of the said Ordinance do hereby make order that the lands or portions thereof be settled as specified in the Schedule to this order. D.M.M.DISSANAYAKA, Assistant Settlement Officer Commissioner of - Land Title Settlement Land Title Settlement Department, Battaramulla 04th July, 2016.
